v.s: Angela sends (Love Waves) in the target direction, dealing 170( +80% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) to enemies hit, revealing their positions briefly, and applying a stack of (Lover's Mark) (up to 5 stacks). Each stack of (Lover's Mark) increases the damage by 20% and slows enemies hit by 8% for 3s.\n(Love Waves) also restore 150( +75% Total Magic Power) HP to allied heroes hit. Angela can store up to 5 charges of this skill and the recharge time is affected by Cooldown Reduction.
Try to store as many charges as you can before attacking, as high stacks of Lover's Mark can result in very impressive damage.

Angela launches a (Puppet String) at the target enemy, dealing 300( +40% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) and gradually slowing them by up to 80%. If the enemy is still connected to the string after 3s, they'll be immobilized for 1.5s and dealt 450( +60% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage).\nEach stack of (Lover's Mark) increases the final damage by 20%.
The follow-up damage dealt when connected is quite high, so try to stay as close to the target as possible.

Angela begins channeling, applying a 1000( +200% Total Magic Power) shield that lasts 6s to the target allied hero regardless of distance. After the channeling is complete, she attaches herself to the allied hero for 12s, during which she can cast skills at zero Mana cost.\nAngela can cast this skill again to cancel the channeling or detach herself from the allied hero. The attaching state will end early if the allied hero is killed.
Protecting low-HP teammates in the nick of time can be very effective in turning the tide of battle.
Angela gains 7.5% extra Movement Speed for 4s each time she casts a skill (up to 30%). When she's attached to an allied hero, the Movement Speed boost is transferred to the allied hero.
Using skills increases her movement speed. Attached allies also benefit from this speed increase.
Unique Passive - Timestream: Hero kills or assists reduce the Ultimate's current cooldown by 30%.
Unique Passive - Gift: Regenerates 20% Max HP and Mana over 2s after leveling up.
Unique Passive - Bless: Received Shield and HP Regen effects are increased by 30%.
Unique Passive - Arctic Cold: Reduces the Attack Speed of nearby enemy heroes to 70% of normal.
Unique Passive - Ice Bound: When a skill deals damage to an enemy hero, it will also slow them by 10% for 2s (stacks up to 3 times). This effect has a 1s cooldown.
